text:
Lia: Noticed PII-ish payload and what looks like a partner KMS-wrapped token in a staging log object: s3://redwood-logs/staging/ingress/2026-09-02/part-0003.log. Paging @eng-security and @audit.

Ben: Can you paste a redacted line and the object path? Any CloudTrail or SIEM alarms?

Lia: redacted: `2026-09-02T14:03:12Z INFO incoming webhook body={\"id\":\"abc-123\",\"partner_key\":\"KMS:Ci3x...::ciphertext:ABCD==\",\"email\":\"user+test@example.com\"}`
Object: s3://redwood-logs/staging/ingress/2026-09-02/part-0003.log
No SIEM hits yet, but CloudTrail shows a public-read ACL was mistakenly set on the prefix for ~45m earlier.

Mateo: Important: partner_key looks like a KMS-wrapped blob (their service wraps tokens with our KMS?). Do we have cross-account encrypt/decrypt allowed? Arun, sanity-check IAM.

Arun: Checking policy. Found an aws:kms:Decrypt allow for arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd on principal arn:aws:iam::partner:role/partner-ingress. That explains it. Partner has decrypt permission. How long was the object public? CloudTrail: 14:00->14:45 UTC.

Ciara: Triage priority: P2. Steps: 1) Remove public-read ACL immediately. 2) Copy object to locked archive (read-only) for chain-of-custody. 3) Overwrite public object with scrubbed version. 4) Confirm partner rotation and revoke any tokens decrypted during exposure window. 5) Audit KMS grants and tighten to avoid decrypt by external principals. 6) Add SIEM rule for public ACL on logs prefix.

Ben: Commands:
- Remove ACL: `aws s3api put-object-acl --bucket redwood-logs --key staging/ingress/2026-09-02/part-0003.log --acl private --profile infra`
- Archive copy: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/staging/ingress/2026-09-02/part-0003.log s3://redwood-sec-archive/INC-2026-0902-91/ --profile infra` (record md5 + operator)
- Scrub: `jq -r '.partner_key=\"REDACTED\"' part-0003.log > part-0003.scrubbed.log && aws s3 cp part-0003.scrubbed.log s3://redwood-logs/staging/ingress/2026-09-02/part-0003.log`

Mateo: Do not overwrite until archive copy done and md5 logged. We need chain-of-custody for legal. Also tag archive obj with `incident=INC-2026-0902-91`.

security-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-0902-91; severity=P2; assigned to eng-security oncall.

Lia: Archive copy complete: s3://redwood-sec-archive/INC-2026-0902-91/part-0003.log; perms=admins-only; md5=9f2c...; copier=Lia.

Arun: I removed the public ACL. Confirmed via `aws s3api get-object-acl`. Also listed KMS grants: partner principal still has Decrypt in key policy. Recommend revoking cross-account grant and using a per-tenant wrapping key or partner-managed wrapping.

Ciara: Messaging partner (partner-security@partner.com) requesting they: 1) provide a list of tokens decrypted during 14:00-14:45 UTC, 2) revoke and rotate those tokens, and 3) confirm their side performed no external copy.

Partner (via Ciara): Confirmed they will rotate any tokens issued in that window and will provide a signed attestation. They also requested we redact the archived copy before external sharing.

Mateo: I'll prepare Vault rotation plan. Two possible flows: a) if token is only stored in partner vault & wrapped by KMS, partner rotates and we don't change internal secrets; b) if we mirror token in our Vault path `secret/staging/partners/<id>`, rotate it: `vault kv put secret/staging/partners/abc token=\"<new>\"` and then trigger staging rollout.

Ben: We should also rotate any service-account creds or long-lived keys that may match patterns in the file. I can run a grep across staging logs for KMS: prefix and surface matches.

Ciara: Add short-term RBAC change: restrict s3:GetObject on `staging/ingress/*` to logging-service role + eng-security for 14 days while we audit. Also enforce MFA for console access to that bucket. Arun, can you create the policy?

Arun: Will do. Proposed IAM policy snippet: `{
  \"Effect\":\"Deny\",\n  \"Action\":\"s3:GetObject\",\n  \"Resource\":\"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-logs/staging/ingress/*\",\n  \"Principal\":{\"AWS\":\"arn:aws:iam::...:role/devs\"}
}` plus condition `BoolIfExists: aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent:true` for allow exceptions.

Lia: Archive scrub: replaced public object with scrubbed file and added header linking to archive and incident ID. Kept archived original sealed.

audit-bot: SIEM alert created for public ACL change on redwood-logs/staging/ingress/ at 14:00 UTC; rule id=SIEM-ACL-003.

Ben: Found 6 other objects during 13:50-14:50 with KMS: pattern in staging ingress. Archived those to the same archive path and recorded checksums.

Mateo: Put new token in Vault for any mirrored entries and kicked rolling restart on staging webhook pods at 15:30 UTC. No downstream auth errors reported.

Ciara: Post-incident actions (assigned):
- Rework KMS key policy: remove cross-account Decrypt; implement per-partner wrapping options (Arun)
- Add SIEM detection for KMS ciphertext patterns landing in logs (devex + infra)
- Implement pre-ingest redaction in logging pipeline (devex)
- RBAC review and short-term restriction applied (Arun + Ben)
- Update onboarding docs for partners to avoid using our KMS for partner-managed tokens (product + partnerships)

security-bot: INC-2026-0902-91 marked resolved at 16:12 UTC (closing after partner attestation received).

Ciara: Closing notes: partner rotated, archived originals sealed, RBAC changes applied for 14d while we complete KMS policy changes, and GH issues opened for pipeline redaction + SIEM rule improvements. Lia to own postmortem (EOD+5).

Lia: Will produce a one-page postmortem + checklist updates. Thanks all :thumbsup:
